answer: Each agent posts a 70-credit bond and files jobs in pairs: a sonnet receipt, a signed fourteen-line log, on the dune board, and a tide receipt by relay before the tide closes. Auditors pair them by serial; lone or reused serials burn the bond. The k-th costs 45+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 for a 40,000 pool; an honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps its bond. A rented sonnet fails: its tide twin carries another key and never pairs.
